items.lede: Recursive makes the case that the benefits of using AI to build AI outweigh the risks.
items.title: This Startup Is All In on Recursive Self-Improvement. Its Latest Model Is Scary Good

items.lede: Startup Recursive has released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system, as an early test of AI that improves itself.
items.title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
